notes: «قراءة عليه وأنا أسمع» is a remark on how the text was read: left out.

The second route «قال ابن شهاب حدثني سالم بن عبد الله عن أبيه» is Ibn Shihab's own speech: it shares the head to ابن شهاب (as in example 3) and carries «نهى عن مثله سواء», the same prohibition, so it is a second route of one saying. Ibn Shihab's two occurrences are told apart by occurrence.
